planner_cost.why_the_projection_was_high: C-FOLD-EXPLAIN-1 §3 priced a row-count reduction (1,495,958 -> 369,796) that the semantics forbid: field_completeness aggregates the exclusion flags over EVERY row of a market, mode_prices over every multi row, and deduped's is_multi branch publishes many rows per virtual question. rn=1 is only the single/binary ELSE arm.
